fusions.name: Burning Felloe
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A ring of fire around you deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and sets each one [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Midsummer Hoop
fusions.desc: Rolls a flaming hoop at the first enemy in its path. It deals 30 damage, and 80% of that to every other enemy within 3 tiles of where it breaks, and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Staked Girandole
fusions.desc: After a 0.4 second cast, plants a fire totem for 12 seconds. Every second it throws sparks at an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Burning] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ember Relay
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, a spark leaps from it to the nearest other enemy within 4 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
